describes: A creature-and-gem collecting world. Copy this file, change the words, run `npm run ui -- --theme <your file>`. You do not need to touch any code.

x.label: how many gems the chest holds

FLU-CONCEPT-01.prompt: Build a chest the gate will let through.

FLU-DEDUCE-01.prompt: Use the scout reports to find the right chest.

FLU-LADDER-01.prompt: Put the collectors in order of who has the most.

QUANT-MIX-01.prompt: Change two amounts so the potion still tastes the same.

QUANT-GRAPH-01.prompt: Pick the chart that matches the hoard growing.

SPA-MAZE-01.prompt: Find the way through the cavern.

SPA-PIPES-01.prompt: Turn the channels so the water reaches the garden.

SPA-SCENE-01.prompt: Put them in the order the dragon sees them.

SPA-VIEW-01.prompt: What does the scout on the ridge see?

GB-EXPLORE-01.prompt: Explore the fog and mark the hidden caches.

GB-ROBOPATH-01.prompt: Program the golem to reach the door.

GB-TRACK-01.prompt: Keep your eye on the jars with sparks in them.

VER-MORPHO-01.prompt: Work out what the old runes mean.

VER-CLOZE-01.sentence: The dragon guards its hoard because it is very ___.
A gem that has never been cut is called ___.
